cards.audioText: Your callsign is UAL811, from Los Angeles to Wuhan, you have received an urgency call from AFR131, AFR131 had a suspected slow depressurization, they are leaving 9800 meters for 3000 meters, please relay this message to Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航811，从洛杉矶飞往武汉，你收到法航131的紧急呼叫，法航131疑似遭遇缓慢释压，他们正从九千八下到三千，请将这则信息转发给郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, message relay from AFR131, AFR131 encountered slow decompression, they are leaving 9800 meters for 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，郑州区调，美联航811，转发法航131的信息，法航131遭遇缓慢释压，他们正从九千八下到三千。

cards.audioText: UAL811, roger PANPAN. Please inform AFR131 they are number one in sequence, and they have the landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，收到PANPAN，告诉法航131他们是第一个，优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Roger, inform AFR131 they are number one in sequence, and they have the landing priority, UAL811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，告知法航131他们是第一个，优先着陆，美联航811。

cards.audioText: Your weather radar shows there is a cumulonimbus ahead of you, ask Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，向郑州区调请求右偏航20海里。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, request 20 miles deviation to the right due CBs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航811，由于积雨云，请求右偏航20海里。

cards.audioText: UAL811, 20miles deviation right of track approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，可以右偏航20海里，脱离天气后报。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation right of track approved, report when clear of weather. UAL811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以右偏航20海里，脱离天气后报，美联航811。

cards.audioText: Tell ATC you are clear of CBs now.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你现在脱离积雨云。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, we are clear of CBs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航811，脱离积雨云。

cards.audioText: You are at 10400 meters, you encountered clear air turbulence. Contact Zhengzhou Control, request climb to a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在10400米，你遇到了晴空颠簸，联系郑州区调，请求上高度。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, request climb due clear air turbulence at 10400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航811，由于10400米有晴空颠簸，请求上高度。

cards.audioText: UAL811, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, UAL811.

cards.audioText:
UAL811, reduce speed to mach decimal 72.
Advise Zhengzhou Control mach decimal 72 is not acceptable, it is too slow for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航811，速度降到马赫数点七二。
告知郑州区调，马赫数点七二不可用，对你飞机来说太慢了。
cards.referenceText: Negative, unable mach decimal 72, it is too slow for my aircraft, UAL811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不可以，不能马赫数点七二，这对我们飞机来说太慢了，美联航811。

cards.audioText: UAL811, maintain mach decimal 75, we are limiting the number of aircraft entering Wuhan Control area due radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，保持马赫数点七五，由于雷达失效，我们正在限制进入武汉区调的飞机数量。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持马赫数点七五，美联航811。

cards.audioText:
UAL811, what is your estimated time over OBLIK?
Advise Zhengzhou Control, your estimated time for OBLIK is 1020Z.
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航811，你预计过OBLIK的时间是多少？
告知郑州区调，你预计过OBLIK的时间是10点20分。
cards.referenceText: Our estimated time over OBLIK is 1020Z, UAL811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 计过OBLIK的时间是10点20分，美联航811。

cards.audioText: UAL811, roger, reach OBLIK earlier than 1020.
You are over OBLIK at time 1015, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating ZF at 1030. Your next waypoint is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在10点15分过OBLIK，高度保持在一万一，预计过ZF时间10点30分，下一航路点WUH，向武汉区调做标准的位置报。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL811, over OBLIK at 1015, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF at 1030, next waypoint WUH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航811，10点15分过OBLIK，高度保持在一万一，预计过ZF时间10点30分，下一航路点WUH。

cards.audioText: UAL811, Wuhan Control, maintain 11000 meters, and report at WUH.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，武汉区调，保持在一万一，过WUH报。
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持在一万一，照办，美联航811。

cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，应答机重新设置为4573进行识别。
cards.referenceTextZh: 应答机重新设置为4573，美联航811。

cards.audioText: Now you are at 5100 meters, ATIS M is received, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在五千一，收到通播M，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL811, 5100 meters, with information M.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航811，五千一，通播M。

cards.audioText: UAL811, Wuhan Approach, expedite descent until passing 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，武汉进近，加速下降直到过四千五。
cards.referenceText: Expedite descent until passing 4500 meters, UAL811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速下降直到过四千五，美联航811。

cards.audioText: UAL811, turn right heading 240, intercept 030 radial BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，右转航向240，切BKM VOR 030径向线。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, intercept 030 radial BKM VOR, UAL811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切BKM VOR 030径向线，美联航811。
